title: Longest and Shortest Lengths of Time

instruction.text: The first clock shows when Darren started mowing his lawn. The second clock shows when he stopped. How long did Darren take to mow his lawn?
Darren then took a break for lunch. The first clock shows when Darren started his lunchbreak. The second clock shows when he finished. How long did Darren stop for lunch?
Did Darren take longer to mow his lawn or to have lunch? Choose the set of clocks which shows a longer period of time.
Jimmy wanted to see how fast he could run 10 kilometres. The first clock shows when Jimmy started running. The second clock shows when Jimmy finished. How long did Jimmy take to run 10 kilometres?
Daniel wanted to see if he could run faster than Jimmy. The first clock shows when Daniel started running. The second clock shows when Daniel finished. How long did Daniel take to run 10 kilometres?
Who ran 10 kilometres faster between Jimmy and Daniel? Choose the set of clocks that shows a shorter period of time.
